data.body: Consideration: [Conflicting assumptions] commands.* values may contain literal semicolons (e.g., chained shell commands like 'cd foo; pytest'). Splitting on ';' would silently fragment them. Resolution path: either escape semicolons, reject at config-load with file:line error, or document that semicolon is reserved and document an escape syntax. Add a fixture exercising the rejection/escape behavior.
